title: Naples, FL — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Naples, FL: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Naples is a city in FL with a population of 22,000. Gulf Coast paradise with world-class beaches, golf, and upnown shopping on Fifth Avenue. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10a growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews older, with a median age of 67.6.
